about: Species label sets (species_com, species_sci, species_taxon_com) for the pocket models remade from regions/us-fl-alachua/species.json as it is now on pub/data-alachua; the published sets were made from an earlier list (645 English names differ). The list's sha256 is written in each labels.json and in card.json. Also marks tinyclip-61m-32's per-channel int8 file as broken in its card.

onnx/vision.int8-per-channel.onnx.why: far from the original model: cosine 0.851 mean, 0.794 lowest, in onnxruntime CPU on the export's 40 parity photos (onnx/parity.json files.int8-per-channel); the evaluation reported 0.858. Do not use.
onnx/vision.int8-per-channel.onnx.use_instead: onnx/vision.int8-per-tensor.onnx (onnx/vision.int8.onnx is a copy of it): cosine 0.9916 in onnxruntime CPU, 0.9929 in onnxruntime-web's WASM build (onnx/parity.json)
